reason: An offline DSH Web UI plugin that adds a movable floating panel containing 18 Canvas-based mini-games with local score and layout persistence.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 添加可拖动的浮动小游戏面板，提供 18 款离线 Canvas 小游戏并保存布局与最高分。
summaries.en: Adds a movable floating mini-game panel to DSH Web UI with 18 offline Canvas games and persistent layout and high-score data.

capabilities: Adds a floating browser UI panel
Persists panel position, width, docking state, and high scores in localStorage
Handles keyboard and mouse input within game areas
Uses pointer lock for the aim-training game
